# COMPETITIVE INTELLIGENCE REPORT
**Feature:** Rewards earning rules display
**Date:** 2024
**Analyst:** HDFC PIXEL Studio Competitive Intelligence

---

## COMPETITORS

### 1. OneCard | Metal Credit Card [DIGITAL-FIRST]
**Why relevant:** Entry-level digital-first card with reward structure that requires user understanding of earning mechanics.

**What they built:** OneCard offers variable reward rates from 0.2% to 2% with targeted offers that appear periodically, requiring users to understand when and how higher rates apply. The card provides a basic reward structure but lacks transparent in-app explanations for why specific rates were earned on transactions.

**One key point:** Low baseline rewards (0.2%) with occasional targeted offers create confusion about actual earning rates without clear rule display.

**Confidence:** High (has URL)

**Source:** https://www.cardexpert.in/onecard-review/

---

### 2. Scapia | Travel Credit Card [DIGITAL-FIRST]
**Why relevant:** Digital-first travel card with complex tiered earning rules (10% online/offline, 5% UPI) that users must understand.

**What they built:** Scapia displays earning rates prominently (10% rewards on online/offline spends, 5% on UPI) with clear redemption mechanics showing "5 Scapia Coins = ₹1" directly in-app. The app emphasizes "no complicated conversions, no hidden conditions" as a core value proposition, suggesting transparency in earning rules is a competitive differentiator.

**One key point:** Scapia explicitly markets earning rule transparency ("no complicated conversions") as a feature to reduce user confusion.

**Confidence:** High (has URL)

**Source:** https://www.scapia.cards/ and https://apps.apple.com/in/app/scapia-a-card-for-travellers/id1625270866

---

### 3. Yotpo Loyalty Platform | Rewards Engine [FINTECH/NBFC]
**Why relevant:** B2B loyalty platform that creates earning rules for merchants, providing infrastructure for displaying why rewards were earned.

**What they built:** Yotpo provides merchant-facing tools to create "earning rules" (formerly campaigns) with specific triggers like product reviews, with documentation showing how to configure and display these rules to end customers. The platform emphasizes motivating customers by explaining reward mechanics ("motivate your customers to talk about their experience").

**One key point:** B2B loyalty infrastructure explicitly documents the need to communicate earning rules to reduce customer confusion and increase engagement.

**Confidence:** High (has URL)

**Source:** https://support.yotpo.com/docs/creating-a-product-yotpo-review-earning-rule

---

## WHITESPACE SIGNAL

**FIRST-MOVER OPPORTUNITY:** No Indian digital-first card or legacy bank found in sources explicitly addresses support ticket reduction through proactive earning rule display, creating opportunity for PIXEL to own "transparent rewards" positioning.

---

## WHAT REAL USERS SAY

**No community signal found in current sources.**

The search results provided do not contain Reddit discussions or app store reviews specifically mentioning confusion about cashback earning rules or support tickets related to rewards transparency.

---

## GLOBAL BEST PRACTICES SUMMARY

### Revolut (Global Neobank Leader)
Revolut's 2024 annual report shows progression from basic features to sophisticated personalization, launching "Revolut 10" as their most substantive app redesign with emphasis on user experience clarity. Their approach to transparency includes real-time notifications and clear product explanations as they scaled to 38 million customers.

**Source:** https://assets.revolut.com/pdf/annualreport2024.pdf

### American Express Platinum (Premium Cards)
Amex Platinum offers "Global Dining Credit" with clear three-year benefit structure showing "up to £300" upfront, demonstrating that premium cards lead with benefit transparency to reduce confusion and increase perceived value.

**Source:** https://evessio.s3.amazonaws.com/customer/0f2483a1-c28e-413f-941a-c62dc776b50e/event/07d300fe-e4a0-4f24-8c68-1b6427690e88/media/General_Content/3666068c-node_TCPA24_Shortlist_Magazine11.pdf

### What Works
- **Proactive display:** Scapia markets "no complicated conversions" as a feature, suggesting users value upfront clarity
- **Real-time context:** Global neobanks use transaction notifications to explain earning mechanics at point of spend
- **Simple math:** Showing conversion rates (e.g., "5 coins = ₹1") reduces cognitive load

---

## RBI COMPLIANCE

**Not found in current sources.** No specific RBI regulations regarding rewards earning rule disclosure were found in the provided search results. Standard RBI guidelines on fair practices and transparent communication would apply.

---

## DIFFERENTIATION HYPOTHESES

### Angle 1: Zero-UI Autopilot
**What to build:** Post-transaction push notification that auto-explains cashback earned with one-tap deep link to full rule library, no in-app navigation required.

**Strategic logic:** Solve the problem at the moment of confusion (after transaction) rather than requiring users to proactively seek information, minimizing friction and support load.

**RBI compliance:** Meets fair practice disclosure requirements through proactive communication at transaction time.

**Build complexity:** Low

**Ops impact:** Requires notification template creation and basic rule engine integration; reduces support tickets by intercepting confusion at source.

---

### Angle 2: Intelligent Earning Coach
**What to build:** AI-powered spending analyzer that predicts next month's cashback based on current patterns and proactively suggests category shifts to maximize earnings (e.g., "Switch ₹5,000 grocery spend to PIXEL Pay to earn ₹500 more").

**Strategic logic:** Transform from reactive explanation to proactive optimization, creating a relationship moment where PIXEL becomes a financial advisor, not just a card issuer.

**RBI compliance:** Requires clear disclaimers that suggestions are projections, not guarantees; aligns with financial literacy promotion.

**Build complexity:** High

**Ops impact:** Requires ML model development, ongoing training data, and customer success team to handle optimization queries; creates stickiness through personalized value.

---

### Angle 3: Social Proof Transparency
**What to build:** Community-visible earning rule leaderboard showing anonymized "Top 10% of users earned 8.5% average cashback this month by using these categories" with one-tap rule comparison against user's own earning.

**Strategic logic:** Leverage FOMO and social benchmarking to make earning rules engaging rather than confusing, positioning PIXEL as the "transparent rewards community" versus opaque competitors.

**RBI compliance:** Requires anonymization of user data and clear consent for aggregated display; no personal financial information disclosed.

**Build complexity:** Medium

**Ops impact:** Requires community moderation guidelines and data anonymization infrastructure; may increase engagement-driven support queries initially but builds self-service culture.

---

## RECOMMENDED ANGLE

**Which angle:** Zero-UI Autopilot

**Why now:** PIXEL is addressing an immediate operational pain (800 monthly tickets) with limited ML/AI infrastructure in place; a notification-based solution leverages existing transaction processing systems and can ship in weeks, not months, while immediately reducing support load and improving NPS at the moment users are most confused.

**Why not the others:**
- **Intelligent Earning Coach:** Requires ML maturity PIXEL likely doesn't have yet; high build complexity delays ticket reduction and risks over-promising on optimization accuracy before earning sufficient training data.
- **Social Proof Transparency:** Creates engagement but doesn't directly solve the "why did I earn this rate" question at transaction time; medium complexity delays impact and may increase comparison-driven support queries before reducing rule confusion.

---

## OVERALL CONFIDENCE

**Confidence Level:** Medium

**Reason:** Strong signal from Scapia that earning rule transparency is a competitive differentiator in Indian digital-first cards, and Yotpo B2B documentation confirms merchant need to explain rules. However, no direct evidence of support ticket volumes or user complaints about earning rule confusion in current sources, so the 800 monthly ticket claim cannot be validated against competitor benchmarks.

---

## SUMMARY

- Scapia explicitly markets earning rule transparency as competitive advantage suggesting user confusion is widespread problem
- No Indian competitor found solving this through proactive post transaction explanations creating first mover opportunity for PIXEL
- Medium confidence due to strong competitor signals but no direct user complaint data in sources

# CS IMPACT ANALYSIS: Rewards Earning Rules Display

## CONTACT DRIVERS (maximum 5, highest likelihood only):

1. **"Why did I get 2% cashback instead of 5%?"**
   - Scenario: User expected higher cashback rate based on merchant category but received lower rate. Doesn't understand spend threshold requirements or exclusions.
   - Likelihood: High
   - PRD gap: No - PRD doesn't specify how exclusions, thresholds, or rate variations are communicated

2. **"Where can I see my cashback breakdown for last month?"**
   - Scenario: User wants historical view of which transactions earned what rates but feature only shows current/recent transaction explanations.
   - Likelihood: High
   - PRD gap: No - PRD doesn't mention historical access or date range filters

3. **"The app says I earned rewards but I don't see them in my balance"**
   - Scenario: Timing mismatch between rewards display and actual credit to account. User sees "earned" message but balance unchanged.
   - Likelihood: High
   - PRD gap: No - PRD doesn't address settlement timing or pending vs credited states

4. **"Why didn't I get airport lounge rewards after spending ₹20,000?"**
   - Scenario: User met spend threshold but doesn't understand combined monthly spend requirement or eligible transaction types. Milestone-based rewards not clearly explained.
   - Likelihood: Medium
   - PRD gap: No - PRD doesn't distinguish between transaction-level and milestone-based rewards display

5. **"My transaction shows 0% rewards - is this an error?"**
   - Scenario: User made purchase in excluded category (rent, wallet loads, fuel surcharge) but exclusion reason not clearly displayed or understood.
   - Likelihood: Medium
   - PRD gap: Partial - PRD mentions showing "why they earned" but unclear if it covers why they DIDN'T earn

## COMPETITOR CX BENCHMARK:

**Contact Driver 1: Rate variation confusion**
- Competitor: Scapia clearly displays spend thresholds upfront ("Unlocks on combined monthly spend of ₹20,000") on marketing pages and presumably in-app
- Approach: Self-serve with proactive threshold tracking
- PIXEL should copy: Real-time progress bars showing "₹5,000 more to unlock 5% rate" before transaction
- PIXEL should improve: Show rate user WILL get at checkout, not just post-transaction explanation
- Source: https://www.scapia.cards/

**Contact Driver 2: Historical breakdown**
- Competitor: Standard practice per Corporate Insight research shows best-in-class reward interfaces include filterable transaction history with per-transaction reward detail
- Approach: Self-serve with export functionality
- PIXEL should copy: Monthly summary view with drill-down capability and CSV export
- PIXEL should improve: Add comparison view "You earned 15% more this month vs last month"
- Source: https://corporateinsight.com/credit-card-reward-redemption-interface-features-and-design/

**Contact Driver 3: Timing mismatch**
- Competitor: Industry standard shows "pending" vs "available" rewards states with expected credit dates
- Approach: Self-serve with clear status labels
- PIXEL should copy: Two-tier display showing "Pending (credits in 2 days)" and "Available to use"
- PIXEL should improve: Push notification when pending rewards become available
- Source: https://corporateinsight.com/credit-card-reward-redemption-interface-features-and-design/

**Contact Driver 4: Milestone rewards**
- Competitor: Scapia uses combined monthly spend thresholds for airport benefits with clear unlock messaging
- Approach: Self-serve with progress tracking
- PIXEL should copy: Separate section for milestone-based rewards with progress indicators
- PIXEL should improve: Predictive messaging "Spend ₹3,000 more by Jan 31 to unlock lounge access"
- Source: https://www.scapia.cards/

**Contact Driver 5: Zero rewards explanation**
- Competitor: Best practice per self-service research shows proactive explanation reduces support contacts by 40%
- Approach: Self-serve with contextual help
- PIXEL should copy: Inline explanation "Wallet loads don't earn rewards per RBI guidelines"
- PIXEL should improve: Link to full exclusions list and suggest alternative earning methods
- Source: https://www.fluidtopics.com/blog/customer-support/7-self-service-best-practices-to-improve-customer-support/

## FAQ COVERAGE (maximum 5 only):

**FAQ 1:**
- Question: Why did I get less cashback than expected on my purchase?
- Answer: Your cashback rate depends on monthly spend milestones and merchant category. Check the transaction in your app - tap any transaction to see the exact rate applied and your current milestone progress. If you're below ₹20,000 monthly spend, you'll earn base rates. Excluded categories like rent payments and wallet reloads earn 0%. Need your specific transaction reviewed? Share the transaction ID.
- Escalation needed: No

**FAQ 2:**
- Question: Where can I see all my cashback earnings from last month?
- Answer: Open PIXEL app > Rewards > Transaction History. Filter by date range to see last month. Each transaction shows the cashback percentage and amount earned. Tap "Download Statement" for a detailed breakdown. Note: Rewards take 2-3 business days to move from "Pending" to "Available" after transaction settlement.
- Escalation needed: No

**FAQ 3:**
- Question: I earned rewards but they're not in my account balance yet?
- Answer: Rewards show as "Pending" for 2-3 business days after your transaction settles with the merchant. Check app > Rewards > Pending section to see expected credit date. Once credited, they move to "Available" balance automatically. If it's been more than 5 business days since transaction date, share the transaction ID for investigation.
- Escalation needed: Yes (if beyond 5 days)

**FAQ 4:**
- Question: I spent over 20000 rupees but didn't get my airport lounge benefit?
- Answer: Airport lounge access requires ₹20,000 combined monthly spend on eligible transactions within the same calendar month. Check app > Rewards > Milestones to see your current progress and which transactions counted. Excluded transactions: rent, wallet loads, EMI conversions, and cash advances don't count toward milestones. Benefits unlock on the 1st of next month after you hit the threshold.
- Escalation needed: No

**FAQ 5:**
- Question: Why does my transaction show zero percent rewards?
- Answer: Certain transaction types don't earn rewards per RBI and card network guidelines: rent payments, wallet loads (Paytm, PhonePe, etc.), fuel surcharges, cash advances, and EMI conversions. Your transaction falls into an excluded category. Tap the transaction in your app to see the specific reason. Regular purchases at merchants earn standard rates based on your monthly spend milestone.
- Escalation needed: No

## AGENT CENTRE REQUIREMENTS:

- **Transaction-level reward calculation breakdown** (rate applied, base rate, bonus rate, milestone status at time of transaction) - NOT IN PRD
- **User's current monthly spend progress** toward each milestone threshold with eligible vs excluded transaction split - NOT IN PRD
- **Pending rewards queue** with expected settlement dates and any holds/disputes - NOT IN PRD
- **Rewards earning history** with date range filter (minimum 12 months) and export capability - NOT IN PRD
- **Merchant category code (MCC)** for disputed transactions to explain rate applied - NOT IN PRD
- **Exclusion rule applied** to each 0% reward transaction with rule reference number - NOT IN PRD
- **Milestone unlock history** showing when user qualified for tier changes - NOT IN PRD
- **Rewards adjustment log** showing any manual corrections or reversals with reason codes - NOT IN PRD
- **User's card program type** and associated reward rate card (different programs may have different rates) - NOT IN PRD
- **Real-time rate calculator** allowing agent to input transaction amount and category to preview rewards - NOT IN PRD

## ERROR SCREEN AUDIT:

**Error 1: Rewards calculation display fails to load**
- Error scenario: API timeout or service unavailable when user taps transaction to see reward breakdown
- Current PRD handling: Not documented
- Recommended next action: Show cached transaction amount with message "Reward details temporarily unavailable. Your rewards are safe and will display shortly. Pull down to refresh."

**Error 2: Historical data incomplete or missing**
- Error scenario: User requests rewards history but data only available for last 30 days due to migration or system issue
- Current PRD handling: Not documented
- Recommended next action: Display available data with banner "Showing rewards from [date]. For earlier history, contact support or download statements from Account > Documents."

**Error 3: Milestone progress shows incorrect percentage**
- Error scenario: Calculation mismatch between displayed progress (e.g., "₹18,000/₹20,000") and actual eligible spend due to pending exclusions
- Current PRD handling: Not documented
- Recommended next action: Show progress with disclaimer "Updates within 24 hours as transactions settle. Excludes wallet loads and other ineligible categories."

**Error 4: Reward rate displayed doesn't match actual credited amount**
- Error scenario: UI shows "5% earned" but actual credit is 2% due to backend rate override or correction
- Current PRD handling: Not documented
- Recommended next action: Display alert "Reward amount adjusted. Tap to see details" linking to explanation and support contact option.

**Error 5: Zero rewards shown without explanation**
- Error scenario: Transaction displays 0% but no exclusion reason provided due to missing MCC mapping
- Current PRD handling: Not documented
- Recommended next action: Show "This transaction didn't earn rewards. Tap 'Why?' for details or contact support if you believe this is an error."

**Error 6: Pending rewards never move to available**
- Error scenario: System failure prevents status update from pending to available after settlement period
- Current PRD handling: Not documented
- Recommended next action: After 5 business days, auto-display message "Rewards taking longer than usual? We're checking on this. Expected resolution: 24 hours. Reference: [auto-generated ticket ID]"

## ESCALATION PATHS:

**Scenario 1: Reward rate dispute - user claims wrong rate applied**
- Who handles it: Tier-2 CS with access to transaction processing logs and MCC verification
- Expected resolution time: 24-48 hours (requires backend rate rule audit)

**Scenario 4: Bulk rewards adjustment needed (system-wide calculation error)**
- Who handles it: Bank team + Zeta ops for mass recalculation and credit

# SPECIFICATION: REWARDS EARNING RULES DISPLAY

## CURRENT STATE SUMMARY:
Today, customers earn rewards based on accelerated (merchant-specific with caps), standard, and exclusion rules configured in the system. Rewards accrue at presentment and reverse on refunds. When customers contact support asking "why did I get X% cashback instead of Y%", agents manually check merchant configurations, MID/TID mappings, and threshold caps across 800 monthly tickets, with no self-serve transparency into the earning logic applied to specific transactions.

---

## SCOPE:

### IN SCOPE:
- Transaction-level earning rule display on transaction detail screen
- Earning rate breakdown showing applied rule type
- Accelerated rewards cap consumption indicator
- Exclusion reason display for zero-earning transactions
- Earning rule explanation for reversed rewards on refunds
- Historical earning rule view for past transactions
- Support ticket deflection tracking for rule-related queries

### OUT OF SCOPE:
- Rewards burning/redemption rule display — separate feature addressing redemption flow, not earning transparency
- Rewards provisioning details to customer — internal accounting process not relevant to customer understanding of earning
- Negative balance auto-billing explanation — edge case affecting <1% users, separate communication needed
- Rewards lapse notifications — separate retention feature with different user journey
- MCC-level exclusion list display — too granular, merchant name sufficient for customer understanding
- Real-time earning rule changes during transaction — rules applied at presentment are final
- Predictive earning calculator for future transactions — requires merchant identification before transaction completion

---

## FUNCTIONAL USE CASES:

### Use Case 1: View earning rule for completed transaction (Happy Path)
**Actor:** PIXEL Credit Card customer  
**Precondition:** Customer has completed transaction that earned rewards, transaction has reached presentment stage, rewards have been credited to account  

**User Story:** As a PIXEL cardholder, I want to see exactly why I earned a specific cashback rate on my transaction so that I understand my rewards without calling support.

**Steps:**
1. Customer opens PIXEL app and navigates to transaction history
2. Customer taps on specific transaction to view details
3. System displays transaction detail screen with rewards earning section
4. System shows earning rule applied: "Accelerated Rewards: 5% cashback on Swiggy (up to ₹500/month)" or "Standard Rewards: 1% cashback"
5. If accelerated with cap, system displays progress: "₹320 of ₹500 monthly cap used"
6. Customer views breakdown and understands earning without external help

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given customer views transaction with accelerated rewards, when transaction detail loads, then earning section displays rule name, rate, merchant match, and cap consumption in single view
- Given customer views transaction with standard rewards, when transaction detail loads, then earning section displays "Standard Rewards: 1% cashback" with no additional complexity
- Given customer views transaction within 2 seconds of detail screen tap, when rewards data is available, then earning rule section renders without separate loading state
- Given customer has multiple transactions on same merchant in same month, when viewing later transactions, then cap consumption reflects cumulative usage across all transactions
- Given transaction earned rewards 30 days ago, when customer views historical transaction, then earning rule displayed matches rule active at transaction presentment date

**Failure State AC:**
- Given rewards calculation is still processing, when customer views transaction detail, then earning section shows "Rewards processing - check back in 24 hours" with estimated completion time
- Given system cannot retrieve earning rule metadata, when transaction detail loads, then earning section shows reward points earned with "Rule details unavailable" and support contact option

**Priority:** P0

---

### Use Case 2: View exclusion reason for zero-earning transaction (Edge Case)
**Actor:** PIXEL Credit Card customer  
**Precondition:** Customer completed transaction on excluded merchant category (fuel/wallet load/EMI), transaction posted but earned zero rewards  

**User Story:** As a PIXEL cardholder, I want to understand why I didn't earn rewards on a transaction so that I know which purchases don't qualify.

**Steps:**
1. Customer notices transaction in history with ₹0 rewards earned
2. Customer taps transaction to view details expecting to see earning
3. System displays transaction detail with rewards earning section
4. System shows exclusion reason: "No rewards earned: Fuel purchases excluded from rewards program" or "No rewards earned: Wallet load transactions excluded"
5. System provides link to full rewards terms showing all exclusion categories
6. Customer understands exclusion policy without contacting support

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given transaction is on excluded MCC, when customer views transaction detail, then earning section displays specific exclusion reason matching merchant category
- Given transaction is EMI conversion, when customer views transaction detail, then earning section displays "EMI transactions do not earn rewards per program terms"
- Given transaction is wallet load to Payzapp/other wallets, when customer views transaction detail, then earning section displays "Wallet load transactions excluded from rewards"
- Given customer taps "View full terms" link, when link is activated, then app navigates to rewards program terms with exclusions section highlighted
- Given multiple exclusion reasons could apply, when transaction detail loads, then system displays primary exclusion reason based on MCC-level rule

**Failure State AC:**
- Given transaction earned zero rewards due to system error not exclusion, when customer views detail, then earning section shows "Rewards calculation pending - contact support if not updated in 48 hours" with ticket creation option

**Priority:** P0

---

### Use Case 3: View reversed rewards explanation on refunded transaction (Failure)
**Actor:** PIXEL Credit Card customer  
**Precondition:** Customer received refund for previously rewarded transaction, rewards have been reversed from account, customer sees negative adjustment in rewards balance  

**User Story:** As a PIXEL cardholder, I want to see why rewards were deducted from my account so that I understand the reversal is linked to my refund.

**Steps:**
1. Customer notices rewards balance decreased and checks transaction history
2. Customer finds original purchase transaction and taps to view details
3. System displays transaction detail showing refund status
4. System shows earning section with reversal explanation: "Original rewards: +50 points | Refund processed: -50 points | Net rewards: 0"
5. System links to refund transaction showing reversal date
6. Customer understands reversal is proportional to refund amount

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given transaction has been fully refunded, when customer views original transaction detail, then earning section displays original earning, reversal amount, and net zero with refund date
- Given transaction has been partially refunded, when customer views original transaction detail, then earning section displays original earning, partial reversal amount, and remaining net rewards
- Given reversal caused negative rewards balance, when customer views transaction detail, then earning section includes warning: "Negative balance will be adjusted from future earnings or billed after 2 statement cycles"
- Given refund processed in different month than original transaction, when customer views detail, then earning section shows both original earning date and reversal date clearly
- Given customer taps refund transaction link, when link is activated, then app navigates to refund transaction detail showing corresponding positive adjustment

- Given rewards reversal is processing but not yet reflected, when customer views transaction detail within 24 hours of refund, then earning section shows "Rewards reversal processing - balance will update within 24 hours"
- Given system cannot match reversal to original transaction, when customer views detail, then earning section shows "Rewards adjustment applied - contact support for details" with ticket creation option

## NON-FUNCTIONAL USE CASES:

### Performance:
- **Transaction detail load time with earning rules**: Earning rule section must render within 2 seconds of transaction detail screen load on 4G connection
  - **Acceptance:** 95th percentile load time <2s measured via Firebase Performance Monitoring across 10,000 transaction detail views

- **Earning rule data cache duration**: Earning rule metadata for transactions >7 days old must be cached locally to reduce API calls
  - **Acceptance:** Cache hit rate >80% for historical transaction views measured via instrumentation, API calls reduced by 60% for repeat views

### Security:
- **Earning rule configuration exposure**: Detailed earning rule logic (MID/TID mappings, exact thresholds, merchant contracts) must not be exposed in client-side code or API responses
  - **Acceptance:** Security audit confirms no sensitive rule configuration in mobile app bundle or API response payloads, only customer-facing descriptions transmitted

### Accessibility:
- **Screen reader support for earning rules**: Earning rule section must be fully navigable and readable via TalkBack/VoiceOver
  - **Acceptance:** Accessibility audit confirms all earning rule text, cap progress indicators, and links have proper labels and reading order

### Reliability:
- **Graceful degradation for missing rule data**: App must display transaction details even if earning rule metadata is unavailable
  - **Acceptance:** Transaction detail screen loads successfully showing basic transaction info + reward points earned with "Rule details unavailable" message when rule metadata API fails, measured via error rate monitoring <0.1% crash rate on detail screen

## INSTRUMENTATION REQUIREMENTS:

### Event 1: zcrw_earning_rule_viewed
- **Trigger:** Earning rule section becomes visible in viewport on transaction detail screen (50% of section visible for >1 second)
- **Properties:**
  - `transaction_id` (string): Unique transaction identifier
  - `rule_type` (string): "accelerated" | "standard" | "excluded" | "reversed"
  - `reward_points_earned` (integer): Points earned/reversed on transaction
  - `cap_shown` (boolean): Whether cap consumption indicator was displayed
  - `time_since_transaction` (integer): Days between transaction date and view date
- **Purpose:** Measure feature adoption and identify which rule types drive most customer interest

### Event 2: zcrw_earning_rule_interaction
- **Trigger:** User taps interactive element within earning rule section
- **Properties:**
  - `transaction_id` (string): Unique transaction identifier
  - `interaction_type` (string): "view_terms_link" | "cap_details_expand" | "refund_link"
  - `rule_type` (string): "accelerated" | "standard" | "excluded" | "reversed"
- **Purpose:** Understand which earning rule details require deeper explanation and optimize content

- **Trigger:** Earning rule metadata API call fails or times out when loading transaction detail
- **Properties:**
  - `transaction_id` (string): Unique transaction identifier
  - `error_code` (string): API error code or timeout indicator
  - `fallback_shown` (boolean): Whether fallback "details unavailable" message was displayed
  - `retry_attempted` (boolean): Whether automatic retry was triggered
- **Purpose:** Monitor reliability and identify systemic issues with earning rule data retrieval

- **Trigger:** User creates support ticket within 5 minutes of viewing earning rule section

  - `seconds_since_view` (integer): Time between earning rule view and ticket creation

### Event 5: zcrw_exclusion_reason_viewed
- **Trigger:** User views transaction detail for zero-earning transaction where exclusion reason is displayed
